text: Trae2api-dsh 是面向 DSH 网页与桌面端的 TRAE CN 模型接入插件。它将 TRAE 账号发现的模型注册为 DSH 原生模型供应商，并提供内嵌控制台。用户可以导入或切换账号、刷新模型目录、选择模型显示状态，并把模型接入对话菜单；服务由插件管理，使用前需有 TRAE CN 或 TRAE SOLO CN 账号。

Trae2api-dsh connects TRAE CN models to DSH web and desktop. It registers discovered models as a provider and adds an embedded console. Users can import or switch accounts, refresh the catalog, control model visibility, and connect models to DSH chat. A TRAE CN or TRAE SOLO CN account is required.

能不能在 DSH 插件控制台刷新和管理 TRAE 模型？
我有多个 TRAE 账号，想切换当前用于模型请求的账号。
How can I use models from my TRAE CN account in DSH?
I want to choose which TRAE models appear in the DSH model picker.
Can I manage TRAE accounts and refresh their model catalog from DSH?
I need to connect account-discovered TRAE models to native DSH chat.
Trae2api-dsh 的功能「TRAE 模型目录」：插件从当前 TRAE 账号发现可用模型及其上下文、输出上限和思考档位，并在 DSH 模型管理中展示。用户可手动刷新目录。
Trae2api-dsh 的功能「账号与模型接入」：用户可导入或切换 TRAE 账号；服务运行后连接操作会把可见模型配置为 DSH 原生供应商，断开时移除该供应商配置。
Trae2api-dsh 的功能「模型显示管理」：用户可搜索模型并逐个或批量显示、隐藏；配置变更后，已连接时同步更新 DSH 模型列表。

**Trae2api-dsh** 让 dsh 使用你在 TRAE CN / TRAE SOLO CN 账号中的模型额度。导入账号后，即可在 dsh 原生对话菜单选择 TRAE 模型和思考强度，使用该账号的额度进行对话。内嵌控制台提供多账号管理、自动签到、账号轮询、用量统计和模型显示设置。

[功能](#功能) · [界面](#界面预览) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [日常使用](#日常使用) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [项目文档](#项目文档)

trae2api-dsh README · 功能：| 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **TRAE 额度接入** | 导入 TRAE 账号，在 dsh 中调用账号提供的模型并使用其模型额度。 |
| **自动签到** | 按北京时间每日签到，跳过当天已签到账号；支持立即执行、上次与下次执行时间及结果查询。 |
| **多账号管理** | 导入已登录的桌面账号或网页授权登录，切换当前账号，分别启用或禁用模型调用。 |
| **账号轮询** | 在有效且启用的账号之间顺序轮询，或根据缓存的剩余积分排序调度。 |
| **模型与思考强度** | 预置 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，发现账号的 Remote / SOLO 模型，按实际能力提供 Low / High / Xhigh。 |
| **模型显示管理** | 在控制台搜索、显示或隐藏模型，支持批量操作；刷新与重启后保留偏好，并同步至原生模型菜单。 |
| **积分与用量** | 查看账号积分、Token、缓存、请求、消费记录和每日汇总。 |
| **完整内嵌控制台** | 保留概览、账号与签到、消费记录、轮询与设置、模型测试；也可在浏览器新窗口打开。 |
| **服务自动管理** | 首次准备后随 dsh 启动；完整退出、Host 结束或禁用插件时回收整个代理进程树。 |
trae2api-dsh README · 功能：自动签到和轮询默认关闭，可在控制台按需开启。关闭窗口到托盘时服务继续运行。

trae2api-dsh README · 环境要求：| 环境 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| dsh | 已验证 **0.2.0-rc.2**，本机 Desktop / Web |
| Node.js | **22+** |
| Python | **3.10+**，包含 `venv` 和 `pip` |
| 账号 | TRAE CN / TRAE SOLO CN，具有目标模型使用权限 |
| 操作系统 | Windows 10/11；Linux 和 macOS 通过 CI 验证 |

本机 Web / CLI 安装需要 `pnpm` 10+；Desktop 使用自带的插件管理环境。首次准备需要联网下载 Python 依赖，无需 Docker。

trae2api-dsh README · 安装：**Desktop**：在 dsh 插件管理器的添加包入口输入以下地址，安装并启用后打开侧栏 **TRAE 控制台**。

```text
https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest/download/trae2api-dsh.tgz
```

**本机 Web / CLI**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest/download/trae2api-dsh.tgz
dsh web
```

可在 [Release](https://github.com/FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh/releases/latest) 下载固定版本和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。不同市场的收录情况见 [市场记录](MARKETPLACES.md)，未收录的市场可能限制安装来源。

trae2api-dsh README · 首次配置：1. 打开 **TRAE 控制台 → 服务设置**，点击 **准备环境**，完成后点击 **启动服务**。
2. 选择 **TRAE SOLO CN** 或 **Trae CN**，点击 **导入当前桌面账号**；也可返回控制台使用网页授权登录。
3. 在 **DSH 模型管理** 点击 **接入 dsh 模型菜单**。
4. 在对话输入框选择模型和思考强度；模型显示或隐藏仍在控制台中管理。

首次启动不会自动导入账号。导入由你主动触发，TRAE 客户端登录文件保持只读。模型名称、可选档位与可用额度以账号返回为准。

trae2api-dsh README · 日常使用：| 要做什么 | 控制台入口 |
| --- | --- |
| 添加、切换账号，设置模型调用开关 | **账号与签到** |
| 设置每日签到或立即执行 | **账号与签到 → 自动签到** |
| 开启顺序轮询或积分优先模式 | **轮询与设置 → 多账号轮询** |
| 刷新模型、搜索、逐个或批量显示/隐藏 | **DSH 模型管理** |
| 查看积分、Token 和消费记录 | **概览 / 消费记录** |
| 准备环境、启动或停止代理 | 顶部 **服务设置** |

积分优先模式使用已缓存的余额排序，可先在账号页刷新积分。隐藏模型会从 dsh 的模型目录移除该项，请先切换仍在使用它的会话；隐藏全部后，重新显示任一模型即可恢复。

trae2api-dsh README · 运行与更新：插件使用独立 Python 环境和本机回环地址。准备完成后自动管理代理生命周期，保留其他供应商和全局模型默认值。账号副本、设置和显示偏好保存在插件自己的数据目录，更新会刷新运行文件并保留这些数据。

项目原名为 `dsh-trae-relay`。从旧包升级请先断开模型、停止并移除旧插件，再添加新包；数据目录和 credential 标识保持兼容。详细步骤见 [升级与数据管理](docs/usage.zh-CN.md#从旧包升级)。

trae2api-dsh README · 常见问题：**关闭 dsh 窗口会停止代理吗？** 关闭到托盘时继续运行；完整退出 dsh、Host 结束或禁用插件时停止代理和签到任务。

**为什么模型列表或思考档位不同？** 插件读取当前账号返回的目录。未提供的档位不会显示，没有公布思考档位的模型使用上游默认行为。切换账号后刷新目录即可。

**端口被占用或找不到 Python 怎么办？** 在服务设置中填写可用的 Python 完整路径，或停止服务后选择空闲端口重新准备。网络下载与环境排查见 [使用指南](docs/usage.zh-CN.md)。

**支持国际版或远程浏览器吗？** 当前面向中国版协议和本机 Desktop / Web。完整控制台使用 Host 回环地址，远程浏览器场景尚未支持。

**卸载会删除账号吗？** 卸载保留插件数据。先断开模型、停止服务；需要彻底清理时再按使用指南移除数据与 credential。

trae2api-dsh README · Introduction：**Trae2api-dsh** lets dsh use the model quota in your TRAE CN / TRAE SOLO CN accounts. Import an account, select its models and reasoning strengths in the native dsh composer, and run conversations using that account's quota. The embedded console provides account management, daily check-in, rotation, usage statistics and model visibility controls.
trae2api-dsh README · Introduction：[Features](#features) · [Preview](#preview) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Everyday use](#everyday-use) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Documentation](#documentation)

trae2api-dsh README · Features：| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **TRAE quota integration** | Import a TRAE account and use its models and model quota from dsh. |
| **Automatic check-in** | Run daily on a Beijing-time schedule, skip accounts already checked in, run immediately and inspect previous/next runs and results. |
| **Multiple accounts** | Import a logged-in desktop account or authorize through the web, switch the active account and enable or disable requests per account. |
| **Account rotation** | Rotate among valid enabled accounts, in round-robin order or an order based on cached remaining credits. |
| **Models and reasoning** | Include a DeepSeek V4.1 Flash preset and discover Remote / SOLO models with their supported Low / High / Xhigh strengths. |
| **Model visibility** | Search, show or hide models individually or in bulk; retain preferences and synchronize the native picker across refreshes and restarts. |
| **Credits and usage** | Inspect account credits, tokens, cache, requests, consumption records and daily totals. |
| **Full embedded console** | Keep overview, accounts/check-in, usage, rotation/settings and model tests, with a separate-browser-window opt
trae2api-dsh README · Features：Check-in and rotation are disabled by default. Enable them in the console when needed. Closing Desktop to its tray keeps the service running.

trae2api-dsh README · First-time setup：1. Open **TRAE 控制台 → 服务设置**, prepare the environment, then start the service.
2. Select **TRAE SOLO CN** or **Trae CN** and import your logged-in desktop account, or return to the console for web authorization.
3. In **DSH 模型管理**, connect the models to dsh's picker.
4. Select a model and reasoning strength in the composer. Manage visibility in the console.

trae2api-dsh README · First-time setup：First startup does not import accounts. You explicitly initiate desktop import, which leaves TRAE client login files unchanged. Your account determines model names, advertised strengths and quotas.

| --- | --- |
| Add or switch accounts, set request permissions | **账号与签到** |
| Schedule daily check-in or run it immediately | **账号与签到 → 自动签到** |

trae2api-dsh README · Everyday use：Credit-priority mode orders accounts using cached balances; refresh account credits first when needed. Hiding removes a model from dsh's configured catalog, so switch sessions still using it first. If all models are hidden, showing any model restores the provider.

trae2api-dsh README · Operation and updates：The plugin uses a private Python environment and a loopback listener. After preparation it manages the relay lifecycle and preserves other providers and global model defaults. Account copies, settings and visibility preferences live in the plugin's data directory; updates refresh runner files while retaining that state.

trae2api-dsh README · Operation and updates：The project was previously named `dsh-trae-relay`. To upgrade, disconnect models, stop and remove the old plugin, then add the new package. Existing data paths and credential identifiers remain compatible. See [upgrading from the previous package](docs/usage.en.md#upgrading-from-the-previous-package) for details.

trae2api-dsh README · FAQ：**Does closing dsh stop the relay?** Closing Desktop to its tray keeps it running. Full exit, Host termination or plugin disable stops the relay and check-in scheduler.

**Why do models and reasoning options differ?** The active account supplies the catalog. Unadvertised strengths are omitted; models without advertised controls use the upstream default. Refresh after switching accounts.

trae2api-dsh README · FAQ：**What if the port is occupied or Python cannot be found?** Supply a working Python executable in service settings, or stop the service and prepare it on an unused port. See the [user guide](docs/usage.en.md) for environment and network troubleshooting.

**Are international accounts or remote browsers supported?** This release targets China-edition accounts and local Desktop / Web. The full console uses the Host's loopback address; remote-browser access is not supported.

trae2api-dsh README · FAQ：**Does uninstalling delete accounts?** Uninstall retains plugin state. Disconnect models and stop the relay first; remove data and the credential reference manually only if you want a complete cleanup.
